result.reason: The redline adds the preferred USD 5M cyber coverage and retains acceptable fallback E&O coverage of USD 1M, workers’ compensation as required by law, and certificates on request. However, it does not require the playbook’s USD 2M aggregate for commercial general liability; the existing USD 1M undifferentiated limit is insufficient. The cyber trigger is also broader than the playbook standard because it applies to mere access and to any Confidential Information, rather than specifically to processing Customer Data. The margin comment does not cure these operative-language issues.
